hero.heading: Window Film and Chip Repair for Las Vegas Homes and Drivers
hero.intro: BC Glass and Tint runs out of 1633 Boulder City Pkwy in Boulder City, a family shop, not a Las Vegas company. Valley customers make the trip anyway, mostly for two reasons: a fair price, and a shop that has done this exact work since 1994. Homes and commercial buildings across the valley get mobile service for window film. Windshield chip repair we do in our own shop, and vehicles come to us for tint and for windshield replacement, which is arranged with a glass specialist we work with, with the glass ordered to your VIN. Every film carries a lifetime manufacturer warranty, and our hours run Tuesday through Saturday, 9 to 5.

content.heading: Fix the Chip Before It Spreads
paragraphs: Nevada summer heat can spread a small windshield chip, so getting it looked at quickly matters.

We repair most chips and small cracks the same day, and insurance sometimes covers it, so we can help with the claim if you need us to. If the damage is too large to repair safely, the replacement is arranged with a glass specialist we work with: the glass is ordered to your VIN, the job gets booked, we help with the insurance claim, and it is finished on the day of your appointment. We will tell you plainly which one your vehicle needs before we touch the glass.

facts.heading: Why the Drive Is Worth It
facts.sub: A few valley-wide facts that make tint and glass work matter here, each one sourced.

items.term: Highs hit 110 degrees or hotter on about 9 days most years.
items.detail: That kind of heat is hard on a car's interior and on an unrepaired windshield chip alike.
items.source: Source: National Weather Service climate normals for Las Vegas, 1991-2020.

items.term: July brings the year's highest midday UV, averaging 9.7.
items.detail: Unprotected UV fades dashboards and upholstery fast, chip or no chip.
items.source: Source: uvindex.io UV index figures for the Las Vegas valley.

items.term: Our ceramic auto film blocks up to 99% of UV.
items.detail: That protection starts the day your vehicle leaves our shop.

drivein.heading: Where Our Las Vegas Customers Drive In From
drivein.text: We see vehicles and mobile service calls from North Las Vegas, Summerlin, Spring Valley and Anthem, along with the rest of the valley. Summerlin in particular already sends us a steady run of new-construction tint work, mostly through referrals from homeowners and window treatment companies rather than a storefront on that side of town. Wherever you are in the valley, the same family shop and the same computer-cut ceramic film handle the job, whether that is a windshield chip in Spring Valley or a whole-house tint job in a brand new Summerlin build.

items.question: How long does an auto tint install take?
items.answer: Most vehicles are done same day.

items.question: When can I roll my windows down after tint?
items.answer: Give the film a few days to fully cure before rolling your windows down. In summer heat about 24 hours is usually enough, and on cooler days give it longer.

items.question: How do I take care of new tint?
items.answer: Do not roll your windows down for the first few days. After that wait about a week before cleaning the film, then use a soft cloth with a mild, ammonia-free cleaner. Ammonia-based products can haze or lift the film over time.
